title: refactor(objectql): move the validate body out of engine.ts into engine-validate.ts (#25522 cut 16)
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEP6zbU3nytnsHfcYKdNRXA)_ Part of #25522 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Ruling-ref: 6348891160 + 6441032442 ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：把 `engine.ts` 里写入预览 `validate`（不落库、按写入路径自己的规则给出每行判定）的方法体原样搬进新文件 `engine-validate.ts`，类上的方法签名与注释不变，只把方法体换成转交；方法体与 `insert` / `update` 共用的 6 个工具函数原地加 `export`、由新文件导入（不复制）。顺带把上一刀遗留的两处 `{@link READABLE_IDS_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH}` 用一个仅类型导入接回（注释文字一字不改）。`engine.ts` 22,189 → 21,733 行。#26680 与 #26778（都改了 `validate` 方法体）已先合入，各自的三处改动随方法体一起搬进新文件。 - **为什么改**：#25522 按缝拆分 `engine.ts` 的第 16 刀。`validate` 是缝表上收益最大的一块（约 −439），之前被「公开 `.d.ts` 逐字节不变」挡住；新裁决 `6441032442`（B）允许仅声明顺序与分块文件名变化，本刀按该裁决切出。 - **风险与回滚**：纯搬移，无行为变化；公开 `.d.ts` 六个文件在裁决规定的归一化后完全相同（声明集、导出集、声明内容逐字节相同，只是分块里声明的先后与分块名变了）；含正控。新文件与 `engine.ts` 互相导入，构建产物里模块顺序只多出新文件一行；一次性探针在新旧两版构建产物上逐行对照（69 行完全一致）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine-validate.ts`（搬入的方法体与 `ValidateHost`）、`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里 `validate` 的转交桩与 6 处原地 `export`、`packages/objectql/src/validate-preview-parent.test.ts`（对齐检查改为从新文件读预览调用）。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-preview-parent.test.ts`，应见该文件全部通过（其中 parity 一组从 `engine-validate.ts` 找到唯一的预览调用）。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 Cut 16 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`), under the claim `6441744054`. The body of `ObjectQL#validate`, the write preview (the write path's own verdict over candidate rows, persisting nothing), moves unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-validate.ts`, behind `ValidateHost`. This is the first cut under the `.d.ts` declaration-reorder ruling `6441032442` (letter B): the published declaration chunk is reordered and renamed, and every declaration file is EQUAL under that ruling's normaliser (report block below, with its positive control). No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/project-thread-cjdmc4` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `fe53769a8e`, which contains cut 15's merge (`378c940b16`, #26645), with `origin/main` merged in at `1685a06dd9` (after #26680) and at `ef7067fdaf` (after #26778). ## What changes ### Why this area Re-measured on `fe53769a8e` with cut 11's measure script and cut 14's price step (`price3.mjs`), both unchanged. `engine.ts` is 21,947 lines, 6,830 of them from the last 30 days (`git blame --since=2026-09-27T12:20Z`, clone deepened to 2026-09-21 first); `class ObjectQL` holds 318 members, 255 methods and accessors. Query-options erasure sites: 8 at base (lines 8286, 9595, 9841, 9905, 10237, 13517, 13816, 18736), none in `validate`'s range.

| price (net lines) | section | taken? | |---|---|---| | -439 priced, **-456 landed** | validate | **yes** (one body: 469 lines at `fe53769a8e`, 345 of them from the last 30 days; 492 once #26680's and #26778's lines arrived) | | -233 | Package, app, plugin and driver registration | no: overlaps open #26337 (`METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` and its `check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` row), as the order says | | -124 | Delete cascade and reference walking | pays less | | -71 or less | count / aggregate, Query lowering, the rest | pays less | | -27 | `resolveFormulaRelated` (Readable-ids security and permission/formula resolution) | no: another section, so not one area with `validate`; a later cut | ### The shape - The class keeps `validate` with name, modifiers, signature, docblock and position. Its body becomes one host literal of exactly the `ValidateHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 16]`, as cuts 8 and 10 to 15 did. Fields go as getters over a `readX` closure (`_registry`, `_writeWallVerdict`, `logger`, `_writeGateProbe`); methods go as late-bound closures (`resolveObjectName`, `permissionResolution`, `resolveDefaultPermissions`, `initializeSummaryFields`, `applyFieldDefaults`, `staticReadonlyCreateStrip`, `mediaValueShapeStrictFor`, `valueShapeStrictFor`, `validationMessageContext`, `buildEvalUser`, `findOne`, `readUpdatePriorRow`, `resolvePreviewParents`, `resolvePredicateRelated`, `resolveOptionPermissions`, and the two the body gained while this cut was in flight: `getSummaryDescriptors` from #26680 and `assertReferencesResolve` from #26778), so a spy or double set on the engine is still the one a call reaches. The body assigns no field, so there is no setter (cut 13's setter ruling has nothing to apply to). `validate` is public with a declared return type (`Promise` of `ValidateDataResponse`), so the inferred-return series limit does not hold it; it has no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, no private-static read and no self-call to `insert` / `update` / `delete`. - **Helpers, under the cut-14 seat ruling.** The body reads seven top-level helpers, each also read by bodies that stay: `undeclaredWriteFieldErrors` and `stripComputedWriteFields` (`insert`, `update`), `droppedFieldEvents` (`insert`), `insertStaticReadonlySubject` (`insert`, `withholdInsertReadonlyFromHooks`), `updateStaticReadonlySubject` (`update`, `staticReadonlyStoredView`), `shouldSkipStateMachine` (`insert`, `update`) and `servedAsStored` (already exported for `engine-master-detail-related.ts`). The six that were not exported gain `export` in place, byte for byte otherwise (leading docblocks included); none moves and none is copied. The module imports the seven as values and `ObjectQL` and `WriteWallRowVerdict` as types from `./engine.js`. It is a new module, so before that it imported nothing from `./engine.js`. `index.ts` and `core.ts` name their exports singly, so nothing new is published. Exporting `insertStaticReadonlySubject` is the export that reorders the published chunk (below); that is what ruling `6441032442` now allows. - **The run-time cycle (measured).** The value import makes `engine.ts` and the module import each other. The module runs nothing at evaluation (declarations only), and `engine.ts` imports it right after `./engine-update-dispatch.js`, which is after every module the body imports (`validation/record-validator`, `validation/rule-validator`, `engine-update-dispatch`, the `@objectstack/spec` subpaths), so the evaluation order of every other module is unchanged. Measured on the built bundles (`index.mjs`, `core.mjs`, `index.js`, `core.js`): with the `// src/engine.ts` region markers set aside (9 at base and at head), the `// src/...` region order at head equals the base's with one line added, `// src/engine-validate.ts`, between `engine-update-dispatch` and `integrity/dangling-reference-audit`. The bundles hold both files in one module, so the published build has no cycle. The late-binding probe answers the same on base and head (Tests). - **Imports.** The module imports `RAW_FILE_VALUES_CONTEXT_KEY`, `EngineQueryOptions` (type), `ExecutionContext` (type), `ValidateDataIssue` and `ValidateDataResponse` (types), `WriteObservabilityOptions` (type), `validateRecordInScope`, `normalizeBlankTypedValues`, `normalizeNumericStringValues`, `ValidationError`, `valueShapeStrictEffective`, `mediaStrictEffective`, `evaluateValidationRules`, `hasParentScopedRequiredWhen`, `stripReadonlyFields`, `stripRuntimeOwnedFields`, `createBatchSummaryAccumulator` (#26680's, which `engine.ts` keeps for `insert`) and `resolveEngineUpdateDispatch` with `EngineUpdateDispatchData` (type). `engine.ts` drops the four whose last reader moved: `ValidateDataIssue`, `RAW_FILE_VALUES_CONTEXT_KEY`, `valueShapeStrictEffective` and `mediaStrictEffective` (each from its existing import line; no line is removed). - **Fold-in: the two stale `{@link READABLE_IDS_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH}`.** The docblocks of `composeReadableIdsAtBoundary` and `composeReadableIdsChain` stay byte for byte; the link now resolves through a type-only import, `import type { READABLE_IDS_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH } from './engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.js'` (a type-only import is erased from the JavaScript; TypeScript counts a `{@link}` as a use), and the constant gains `export` in place in that module (one home, unchanged value). Measured first the other way, and dropped: re-wording the two docblocks to name the module changed the published chunk, because those PRIVATE members' docblocks are printed in the `.d.ts` (`private composeReadableIdsAtBoundary;` under its docblock). That is a change inside the `declare class ObjectQL` statement, outside ruling `6441032442`'s bar, so it was not kept. With the type-only import the head `.d.ts` is byte-identical to the ruling's measured variant (below). - The module header names what moved, how the body reaches the class, and how the helpers were handled. ### Net lines (the seat's rule) `engine.ts` goes from 22,189 to 21,733 lines, **net -456** (44 added, 500 removed). The module is 607 lines. The diff against `origin/main` is 1,187 changed lines over 5 files (+671 / -516). ### Readers of the moved lines - **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` site register.** The body's one `isSystem` read (the caller-write strips' gate) moves with it, so the generated register's anchor `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#validate` (1 read, row 21b) becomes `packages/objectql/src/engine-validate.ts#validate`, rebuilt by `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs --write` (after `git add -N` of the module), never by hand. Row 21b's `Symbol` cell names `validate` by symbol, so it stays. `scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs`'s `NON_READ_ANCHORS` has no `validate` row. - **`packages/objectql/src/validate-preview-parent.test.ts` (f), the preview/write parity pin.** It read `engine.ts` and attributed each `evaluateValidationRules` call to its enclosing class method, the one in `validate` being the preview. The preview's call now lives in the module's top-level function `validate`, so the reader reads both files and attributes a call to its enclosing method OR function, and names the file in its messages. The writes still come from `engine.ts`. It still finds exactly one preview call (`toHaveLength(1)`), so it cannot pass empty. - No other census, ADR anchor, docs row or test key names `validate` by `engine.ts` path: `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointers under `packages/spec/**`, `docs/**`, `content/**` and `scripts/**` name none of the moved names; `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys none; the body calls no `canReadObject(` (core's `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` is unchanged) and no `referenceTargetOf(` (core's `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` is unchanged); it holds no `query-options/no-any-erasure` site (8 at base and head), no tenant-audit untyped receiver and no private-static read. - **No ADR anchor paragraph describes the moved body** (the `engine.ts` entry is the transaction-seam paragraph), so the module needs no anchor entry of its own. - **Read-seam census (the cut-21 trap of #25467).** `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` at base and head is identical once line numbers are masked: 48 durability seams and 88 read seams (at base `ef7067fdaf`), the same entries; `validate` is named in none. - **Decision-letter count:** `check-adr-anchors` at base `ef7067fdaf` (clean detached worktree): **1,898** decision-letter citations on the anchored surface, 59,978 resolving citations across 8,400 files. At head: **1,898**, 59,978 across 8,401 (the +1 file is the new module). The count held at the earlier bases too (`fe53769a8e` and `1685a06dd9`: 1,871 = 1,871). The moved body cites `ADR-0104` and `ADR-0113` without a decision letter, so no letter leaves the anchored surface. ## Why #25522 splits `engine.ts` one seam at a time so that a change to one area reads, reviews and conflicts as that area alone. `validate` is the area that pays most (the seam table) and the one ruling `6441032442` freed; #26680 and #26778, which edited its body while this cut was in flight, have landed and are carried here (Acceptance notes). Nothing about what the engine does changes. ## Tests No test is added. One test's source reader is migrated with the body (above): the move is proved by identity, not by new behaviour.
